prompt.text:
Implement `createArchive()` and export exactly `{ createArchive }` using `module.exports`. It returns an isolated in-memory archive with methods `createDocument(data)`, `deleteDocument(id)`, `addContributor(id, contributor)`, `removeContributor(id, contributorId)`, `addAttachment(id, attachment)`, `removeAttachment(id, attachmentId)`, `updateDocument(id, changes)`, `listDocuments()`, `getDocument(id)`, and `listAttachments(id)`.

A document has `{ id, title, notes, contributors, attachments }`. New document data must be a non-array object with non-empty string `id` and `title`; `notes` is optional and defaults to `""`, but if supplied must be a string. Duplicate IDs throw `Error("Document exists")`. Contributors require non-empty string `id` and `name`; attachments require non-empty string `id` and `label`. Duplicate child IDs within their respective list throw `Error("Item exists")`.

Every method taking a document ID requires a non-empty string. Missing documents throw `Error("Document not found")`. Removing a missing child returns `false`; successful removal returns `true`. Adding returns the resulting document snapshot. `deleteDocument` returns `true` if removed and `false` if absent.

`updateDocument` accepts a non-array object containing any combination of `title` and `notes`. An empty changes object is allowed. `title` must remain a non-empty string and `notes` must be a string. Any other own key, including `id`, `contributors`, or `attachments`, throws `TypeError("Invalid changes")`.

Documents are listed in creation order; contributors and attachments retain insertion order. All getters and mutation results must be deep snapshots: callers must never receive or introduce aliases to archive-owned objects. Invalid record shapes throw `TypeError("Invalid record")`. Each archive instance has independent state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
